Task: Keep access when one of a member’s two subscriptions ends

Completion criteria:
- An integration fixture seeds two confirmed subscriptions for one member
- Reconciliation forfeits the canceled subscription without downgrading the member while the other remains confirmed
- Access becomes Free only after the remaining subscription ends

Task: Alert staff when the entire membership review sweep cannot start
Why it matters: Per-subscription failure alerts cannot advance when the database connection or shared Stripe client fails before the sweep reaches any subscription. A prolonged global outage could leave every founding subscription unchecked.
Completion criteria:
- Persistent startup-level sweep failures are visible only to staff, without member payment details.
- A later healthy sweep automatically resolves the global warning.
- Brief outages do not alert staff.

Task: Notify the owner when billing review failures continue without a membership-page visit

- Retries do not send duplicate notices; recovery resolves the outstanding notification.
- Members cannot see the notification or its metadata.

Task: Keep a slow earlier profile request from replacing a newer save
Why it matters: The current protection handles replies received out of order after the server committed them. If the first PATCH itself reaches the database after a second PATCH, the old details can still be stored last.
Completion criteria:
- Profile writes use an explicit version or comparable concurrency control at the API boundary
- A delayed older server-side write cannot replace a newer committed edit
- The member sees a clear conflict or safe retry path

Task: Show profile changes made in another tab without stale details

Completion criteria:

- In-progress form edits are not silently overwritten during refresh
- A two-tab check covers the visible name and bio

- Tests verify both privacy of deleted answers and late retry behavior
